core_obligations: Reduce by the criterion (proof lines 13843-13845): apply the characterisation of the constructible finite type category to reduce the question to finite complexes of flat constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules.

Conclude (proof lines 13846-13847): the statement then follows because the pullback of sheaves f^{-1} = f^* is exact and the pullback of a constructible sheaf is constructible, so a finite complex of flat constructible sheaves pulls back to one of the same kind.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to finite complexes of flat constructible sheaves by the characterisation criterion.
Use exactness of the pullback and constructibility of pullbacks to conclude.
